claims.claim: Verifact Markets emerged from stealth last week to trade disputed facts about events that already occurred, backed by Positron Capital Management, with Rodrigo Aquino as CEO.
claims.episode_span: Verifact Markets emerged from stealth last week with markets on disputed factual claims
claims.source_title: Prediction markets get a new twist: betting on what's already happened
claims.supporting_quote: Verifact Markets, which emerged from stealth last week, is positioning itself as a distinct alternative to platforms like Kalshi and Polymarket.

claims.claim: Verifact True or False contracts are priced between $0 and $1, and markets resolve only above a greater-than-90-percent confidence threshold or else expire at the last trusted trading price.
claims.episode_span: resolves a market only when confidence is greater than 90 percent
claims.source_title: Prediction markets get a new twist: betting on what's already happened
claims.supporting_quote: A market resolves only when Verifact reaches a confidence threshold (the company cites greater than 90%) in either outcome.

claims.claim: Kalshi is donating $3 million to Housing Works, the largest single-donor gift in the nonprofit’s 36-year history, centered on the 125th Street Health Center in East Harlem.

claims.claim: The Globe and Mail, citing a Northwestern Mutual study from earlier this year, said about one-third of Gen Z ages 14 to 29 are participating or plan to participate in prediction markets or sports betting, and cited a Betterment finding that about one-quarter of Gen Z investors treat sports betting as part of a long-term strategy.
claims.episode_span: about one-third of Gen Z — defined there as ages 14 to 29
claims.source_title: The uphill battle of protecting our kids against prediction markets
claims.supporting_quote: In the United States, where the market is more developed, about one-third of Gen Z (that’s 14- to 29-year-olds) are either participating in or plan to participate in prediction markets or sports betting, according to a study Northwestern Mutual conducted earlier this year.

claims.claim: The Globe and Mail cited a recent study finding that 1 percent of Polymarket users captured about 77 percent of the profits, and said Canadians can participate at 18 or 19 depending on the province.
claims.episode_span: 1 percent of users on U.S.-based Polymarket captured about 77 percent of the profits
claims.source_title: The uphill battle of protecting our kids against prediction markets
claims.supporting_quote: A recent study showed that just 1 per cent of the users on the U.S.-based Polymarket platform captured about 77 per cent of the profits, and those winners adopt complex strategies that most people would not be able to deploy.

claims.claim: A 2018 Journal of Modelling in Management paper found in artificial-market simulations that LMSR forecast standard error falls as the liquidity parameter rises, and that for any given number of traders an optimal parameter yields appropriate price adaptability and the fastest convergence.
claims.episode_span: Forecast standard error fell as the liquidity parameter rose.
claims.source_title: Optimizing the liquidity parameter of logarithmic market scoring rules prediction markets
claims.supporting_quote: The simulation results indicate that prediction market’s forecast standard error decreases as the value of the liquidity parameter increases.
